reading: Byte strings the shipping entrypoint must not contain (#465 Phase C PR-C2, docs/reference/native_runtime_resolved_config.md §18): the measurement hooks and the developer options live only in the _measurement variant of the runtime libraries and in saccade_track_measurement (SACCADE_SHIPPING_MEASUREMENT_HOOKS). Checked on saccade_track after every build (cmake/check_no_measurement_surface.cmake) and on the installed tree (scripts/native/check_shipping_bundle.py static, entrypoint_no_measurement_surface). 'Mutation', '_mutation', ' mutation' and 'mutation_' cover the mutation enums, their name / parse functions, the setters and members, and the error messages; '_for_measurement' the measurement setters; then the developer build's name and options and every mutation name. Not 'measurement' or 'mutation' alone: the tracker's Kalman filter names a 'measurement' and the config checks have 'PermutationOf' (both in a debug build of the shipping entrypoint). tests/unit/test_shipping_measurement_surface.py keeps the list complete against the sources.
